# tosijs-product v0.6.0

Scroll-linked animation components for tosijs.

- Docs: https://product.tosijs.net
- Source: https://github.com/tonioloewald/tosijs-product
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tosijs-product

## Documentation

Each component's full documentation (with live code examples) is
embedded in its distributed JS file as inline comments. Read the
relevant dist/*.js file for complete docs, usage examples, and API.
